# Asset licences

Every file under `assets/` has a row here. The rows between the sync markers are written by
`tools/sync_from_threejs.py` (copies from `chennai-open-world/`, decision G-3); add rows for new
assets (for example the new cast in `assets/people/`) outside the markers.

### MakeHuman assets used (none ship as-is: they are baked, recoloured and joined into the GLBs)

Where a pack page and an asset file disagree, the stricter licence is used; assets whose file
says anything other than CC0 or CC-BY (for example AGPL3 skirts and tops in the same packs) are
not used. No CC-BY asset is used by the current cast (the CC-BY banian vest of the Three.js cast
is not worn by anyone here).
